map.不能。生成逻辑与字符集都在前端，攻击者直接读 JS 就能绕过；真正有效的验证码必: No. Both the generation logic and the character set live in the front end, so an attacker can simply read the JavaScript and bypass it; an effective CAPTCHA must be generated and verified server-side, be single-use and carry an expiry. Modern practice favors behavioral verification or one-time codes sent by SMS or email.
